sentences: This bill would replace the existing Child Dental Benefits Schedule with a new Child and Adult Public Dental Scheme.
The Commonwealth would provide capped funding to the states through a National Partnership Agreement, with the states covering the remaining costs and managing service delivery.
The scheme would run from 1 July 2016 for five years, with a review after four years, and aims to treat an extra 600,000 patients each year.
changes: Establishes a Child and Adult Public Dental Scheme to replace the Child Dental Benefits Schedule.
Creates a National Partnership Agreement for Commonwealth funding to states for public dental services.
Sets the Commonwealth contribution at 40 per cent of the efficient price of dental services.
Requires a review of the scheme after the fourth year to inform the next agreement.
Expands eligibility to all children and adults on concession cards.
summary.affected: Public dental patients, including children and adults on concession cards, and the states that provide public dental services.
